evidence: The decomposition of trimethylgallium (TMGa) on the gallium-rich GaAs(100) surface was studied with temperature programmed desorption, Auger electron spectroscopy, and low-energy electron diffraction. ... Experiments were performed in two separate ultrahigh vacuum systems which are described in detail elsewhere. One system employed a conventional electron impact ionization quadrupole mass spectrometer (QMS), while the other system utilized a time-of-flight mass spectrometer (TOF) and resonantly enhanced multiphoton ionization (REMPI) which was used to unambiguously identify desorbing methyl radicals.
